subject: BrightGrid MAP: checkpoint sequencing and tranche rewrite
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@brightgrid.com>, BrightGrid Procurement <procurement@brightgrid.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightGrid MAP: eval weeks & pricing tranches

Hi Samir / Procurement team,

Attached is our working MAP (v2) for BrightGrid's eval and onramp. Key points below — please review and confirm footprint and the procurement timeline so we can lock pricing into the SOW draft:

- Evaluation window: 4 weeks (April 4–May 1) with two technical checkpoints (end of week 1 and week 3) for model-quality signoffs.
- Checkpoint milestones and commercial triggers:
  • CKPT-1 (W1): Access + integration validation — no commit required, small technical credit applied (1K tokens/month equivalent).
  • CKPT-2 (W3): Feature validation and latency SLO target met — proposed soft commit (10% of first tranche) and 5% discount on first month if signed within 10 business days of report.
  • Post-eval Onramp (Month 1–3): Tranche A (0–50k tokens/day) with tiered pricing; Tranche B (50k–200k) with committed pricing and a 10% ramp rebate tied to 90% usage of Tranche A in month 1.
- Pricing ask: we proposed a staged unit price that steps down as committed ramp is met. See attached pricing matrix (BrightGrid-MAP-v2.xlsx).
- Timing: we'd like sign-off on MAP and SOW by Apr 6 to meet your procurement deadline.

Three asks for you:
1) Confirm whether procurement needs purchase-order language in the SOW (we can add).
2) Confirm target total monthly committed usage (rough band is fine).
3) Approve the evaluation checkpoint dates above or propose adjustments.

If it's helpful I can schedule a 30-min alignment call early next week to walk through the attachment.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightGrid MAP: eval weeks & pricing tranches

Vanessa —

Thanks for sending this through. The eval window and checkpoint cadence look reasonable. A few notes from our side after a quick review:

- Procurement timeline: we are on a compressed calendar and need a final SOW/price lock by Apr 8 to hit April production onboarding.
- Tranche flex: procurement is asking whether you can split the first tranche into two micro-tranches (0–25k and 25k–50k) since our internal pilots target smaller starting spikes. Can you reflect micro-tranche pricing?
- Discount mechanics: please clarify whether the 5% checkpoint discount is additive to the ramp rebate or exclusive. We need a clean math example in the SOW.
- Data residency: we need confirmation that no customer data leaves our US-only VPC during the eval.

I can make time Mon morning for a 20-min call if helpful. Procurement is looped and will review the SOW draft once you include the PO language.

Best,
Samir
Head of Platform
BrightGrid
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightGrid MAP: eval weeks & pricing tranches — pricing iteration request from customer

Team — forwarding Samir's ask. Summary of items we should address in MAP v3 before sending SOW:

1) Micro-tranche split for Tranche A (0–25k, 25k–50k). Propose pricing:
   - 0–25k: $0.045 / unit
   - 25k–50k: $0.038 / unit
   (then existing Tranche B pricing at $0.032 beyond 50k)
2) Discount stacking: recommend wording that ramp rebate applies on top of checkpoint discount but rebate requires meeting usage thresholds in the month following checkpoint. Provide worked example in the SOW.
3) Early ramp credit: offer a one-time $5k onboarding credit if BrightGrid signs MAP+SOW by Apr 6 and exceeds 60% of Tranche A usage in month 1. This helps close before your Apr 8 procurement lock.
4) Data residency: confirm with Infra — we can offer US-only private deployment during eval; attach security confirmation snippet in final SOW.

Please advise on approval of the pricing numbers above or suggest adjustments. If we keep the onboarding credit, we should pre-authorize finance for up to $5k in one-off credits under deal BG-2027-057.

Quick notes: HubSpot deal updated with these asks: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 — I added procurement deadline and DocuSign placeholder.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Samir / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick replies and for surfacing the micro-tranche ask. Attached is MAP v3 and a clean SOW draft that incorporates:

- Micro-tranche pricing for Tranche A and Tranche B pricing (see pricing table, BrightGrid-MAP-v3.xlsx).
- Clear discount stacking rules: checkpoint discount (5%) applies to the invoice for the month in which the checkpoint trigger is recorded; ramp rebate (up to 10%) is applied as a post-invoice credit once usage thresholds for the preceding month are met. Worked example included on page 4.
- One-time onboarding credit: $5,000 if BrightGrid signs MAP+SOW by Apr 6 AND achieves >=60% of 0–25k micro-tranche in month 1 — credit applied to month 2 invoice.
- Data residency: confirmed US-only private eval deployment (security attestation paragraph added to SOW).

Action items for BrightGrid:
1) Confirm agreement to MAP v3 and SOW terms (sign via DocuSign link below) by Apr 6 to secure onboarding credit and pricing.
2) Confirm PO language required; if you need specific contract verbiage, send procurement language and we will incorporate before sign.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/ABC123
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Thanks again — happy to jump on a 20-min sync Wed morning if useful.
